column3: BSB moves “I appeal to the elders among you” to the end.
BSB follows the critical text with “because it is God’s will” (according to God).
BSB follows the critical text without the Textus Receptus “being subject to one another.”
BSB follows the critical text without “because,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB follows the critical text with “you” and “in Christ”; the Textus Receptus reads “us” and “in Christ Jesus.”
BSB follows the critical text with “the power”; the Textus Receptus reads “the glory and the power.”
BSB follows the critical text with “Stand firm in it” (στῆτε).
BSB follows the critical text: “in Christ” without “Jesus,” and no “Amen.”
